integrity_note: Finite claims supported by explicit integer codes, output transversals, exact rational primal/dual certificates and weighted conflict-clique covers; both standalone finite checkers were executed. No external certification is asserted.
scientific_limitations: The exact integer and fractional optima are proved only for lengths one through seven and for binary inputs with no adjacent ones and free endpoints.
Only one ordinary deletion from indexed words is modeled; neither cyclic equivalence nor constrained received outputs are assumed.
Some older relevant primary full texts were inaccessible, so historical priority has residual risk.
Independent scientific audit and independent historical-priority review have not been performed.
title: First fractional deletion-packing gaps for Fibonacci-constrained binary words
